_what: What the 2.0 surface publishes in tools/list, spelled as LITERALS. This is the rename oracle for the 2.0-era names: every other assertion about them in the test project reads a ToolNames constant, so it follows a change to that constant's VALUE and cannot notice a typo. These literals do not follow. The 1.9 capture beside this one does the same job for the 45 names 1.9 shipped, and it anchors 39 of the 46 here; seven - housecarl_apply, _check, _copy, _create, _forward, _records, _remove - post-date 1.9 and had no literal anchor outside the retiring guard harness until this file.
_source: The server built from this repo, not a release asset. Provenance is the build, so this file is re-captured deliberately rather than trusted from an earlier one.
_method: The built housecarl-mcp.exe driven over stdio against a fresh empty HOUSECARL_DATA_DIR: initialize -> notifications/initialized -> tools/list, names sorted ordinal. Same method as the 1.9 capture. Not reconstructed from source and not read off the [McpServerTool] attributes - the attributes are the side this is here to check.
_maintained: NOT frozen, unlike the 1.9 capture: 1.9 is history and final, this is the live surface. A new 2.0 tool adds its name here BY HAND, in the same commit as its ToolNames constant, and a tool deleted at the cut has its name removed here in the same commit. Both directions are tested - a name here that is no longer published is red, and a published name missing from here is red naming the tool - so the by-hand step is enforced rather than remembered.
